vagas.titulo: Open Source Maintainer / Core Contributor – Software Engineer
vagas.descricao:
**Join a leading AI lab's cutting-edge GenAI team to be at the core of the AI revolution, where your expertise fuels the development of the most advanced Large Language Models.**

# 1\. Overview

Join a leading AI lab's cutting-edge GenAI team and help build foundational AI models from the ground up. We're seeking talented open-source maintainers and core contributors with deep, hands-on ownership of a mature, widely used open-source codebase to bring real-world engineering and code review judgment and elevate the quality of our AI training data. This role is a commitment of 30–40 hours per week.

You'll be engaged through Cincinnatus LLC, with the opportunity to be placed at a leading AI lab as part of their extended workforce.

# 2\. Key Responsibilities

- Guide research and engineering teams to close knowledge gaps and improve AI model performance in software engineering, code review, and open-source maintenance topics.
 
- Design challenging, realistic engineering tasks grounded in the open-source codebase the expert knows best, such as the features, refactors and bug fixes a maintainer would assign, and write accurate, well-structured reference solutions.
 
- Evaluate AI-written code, tests and grading rubrics against the repository's architecture, conventions and quality bar, and provide clear, written technical feedback.
 
- Build, run and test the project locally, including with Docker, to confirm that tasks, solutions and tests behave as intended.
 
- Write precise rationales that explain what a strong solution looks like and where AI-generated changes fall short.
 
- Collaborate with other subject matter experts to ensure consistency and accuracy in training data.

# 3\. Core Qualifications

- Maintainer (named in MAINTAINERS or CODEOWNERS, or 10+ PR reviews in the last 12 months) or core contributor (3+ substantive merged PRs in the last 12 months) of a widely used open-source project.
 
- The repository is 2+ years old, has real users and an active code review culture, and is primarily human-written.
 
- Years of sustained open-source contributions, with a public history that can be verified against the candidate's own GitHub account.
 
- Senior-level code review judgment, including the ability to critically assess AI-written code, tests and edge cases.
 
- Hands-on ability to build and run the project and its test suite locally, including with Docker.
 
- Ability to engage reliably for 30–40 hours/week during weekdays on an exclusive basis: no other full-time role and no other AI training or evaluation projects, including other Mercor projects, during the engagement.
 
- Authorized to work in the country you live in.
 
- Able to complete any necessary background checks and confidentiality agreements before starting, and to work on a company-provided device to protect the security of information.
 
- Writes all rationales and feedback personally, in their own words.
 
- Strong written communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical decisions clearly.

**About Cincinnatus LLC:**
Cincinnatus LLC is an enterprise staffing company that partners with leading technology companies to source and employ highly skilled professionals for contingent and contract-based opportunities. Cincinnatus serves as the employer of record for these engagements, providing employment, payroll, benefits, and compliance, while placing professionals directly within client teams to work on high-impact initiatives.

About Turing:
 Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
 Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

 Role Overview: 
 We are looking for experienced Nurse Practitioner /healthcare professionals to participate in a beta-testing initiative for a healthcare technology product being developed by a leading technology company.
 Selected professionals will explore the product, complete predefined testing activities, and share feedback based on their clinical experience and practical knowledge of healthcare workflows.

 Responsibilities 
 • Test the product by following predefined tasks and workflows.
 • Evaluate the usability, interface, and functionality of the product.
 • Share feedback on the product’s relevance to everyday clinical practices.
 • Identify potential issues, gaps, or inconsistencies.
 • Suggest improvements based on professional experience.
 • Provide clear and structured feedback through designated platforms or forms.

 Requirements 
 • Active Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA) license or relevant professional registration .
 • Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience .
 • Clinical background in one or more of the following areas is preferred: • Primary Care
 • Family Medicine
 • Internal Medicine
 • Pediatrics
 • Emergency Care
 
 • Currently based in the United States. 
 • Comfortable working with digital healthcare tools and technology platforms.
 • Ability to follow predefined instructions and workflows accurately.
 • Strong attention to detail and ability to provide structured feedback.

 Additional Information 
 • Remote engagement.
 • Flexible scheduling, subject to project requirements.
 • Compensation and participation details will be discussed during the recruitment process.
 Evaluation Process -
 • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
 • Finalized talents will go through delivery interview or assessment & proceeded further accordingly.
